run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run — identical network constraint to all recent runs. The session egress proxy denied every direct HTTPS connection to tender hosts: curl returned "403 CONNECT tunnel failed" for www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au and service.ariba.com, and WebFetch returned DNS ENOTFOUND for www.tenders.gov.au. No buyer-originated portal, detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened, so discovery was limited to the WebSearch tool (US-indexed, returning mostly stale mid-2026 cached snapshots, JavaScript-disabled portal shells and third-party aggregator pages). Tier 1 (AusTender, NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, ACT) were swept via search. Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel/TenderLink, universities/NCI, water/energy GBEs such as Sydney Water/Melbourne Water/Transgrid, Australia Post, public health) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside NeoSmelt JV, Brisbane City Council Ariba) were checked via search. Every corporate channel remained registration/login-gated with no publicly-visible open RFx. Three future-dated, buyer-originated government opportunities were surfaced via aggregator/cached snippets and are carried at headline level only, explicitly flagged as UNVERIFIED against the primary portal. No opportunity was fabricated; leads that resolved to closed or invitation-only notices were excluded and noted in gaps.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK: all direct HTTPS to tender hosts denied by the session network policy (403 CONNECT tunnel failed / DNS ENOTFOUND). To restore full discovery, the following hosts (at minimum) must be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au (buy.nsw.gov.au), www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com.

All three carried tenders are UNVERIFIED headline-level entries from aggregator/cached search snippets; their tender_id, dates, buyer and scope could not be confirmed on the buyer-originated primary portal this run. They need a detail/verification pass once egress is restored.
No deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria extraction was possible for any opportunity — every detail page and tender document was unreachable.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, Telstra, EstimateOne) remained registration/login-gated; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only.

Excluded leads (not fabricated): DFAT-1096 Australian Volunteers Program REOI appears to close 9 Nov 2026 (effectively closed as of the run date); DFAT-1039 PNG ESIP 2 is to shortlisted/invitation-only organisations (out of scope); NeoSmelt JV procurement (BlueScope/BHP/Rio Tinto/Mitsui/Woodside) earlier EOI closed Dec 2025 and main procurement is a future (post-FID) activity.
WebSearch is US-indexed and returned predominantly stale or aggregator data; recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted this run.
